calls.sun: wakusei getTimes(noon) and suncalc getTimes(noon) with noon the local mean noon; astronomy-engine SearchAltitude(Sun, -0.833 deg) from 12 h before it, one day
calls.moon: wakusei getMoonTimes(midnight, lat, lng, 0) and suncalc getMoonTimes(midnight, lat, lng, 0) for the UTC day; astronomy-engine SearchRiseSet(Moon) from UTC midnight, one day
